# Huy Store - Next.js Turborepo Project

## Project Structure
This is a Turborepo monorepo project with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and DaisyUI.

## Stack
- **Monorepo**: Turborepo
- **Framework**: Next.js 14
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS + DaisyUI
- **Package Manager**: npm

## Development
Run `npm install` to install dependencies.
Run `npm run dev` to start the development server.

## Project Status
✅ Turborepo scaffolded
✅ Tailwind CSS configured
✅ DaisyUI integrated
✅ Landing page created
